প্রজ্ঞাপন
তারিখ: ২০ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২৭ বঙ্গাব্দ/৩ জুন, ২০২০ খ্রিস্টাব্দ

Ministry of Finance: This is the government ministry responsible for the internal resources division and oversight of customs and value added tax matters.
Internal Resources Division: This is the administrative department under the Ministry of Finance tasked with the governance and regulation of customs and value added tax policies.
Customs: This refers to the regulatory and operational domain governing the import and export of goods, overseen by the Internal Resources Division.
Value Added Tax: This refers to the consumption-based tax system managed and regulated under the authority of the Internal Resources Division.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: এস.আর.ও. নং- ১৩৩-আইন/২০২০/৮৪/কাস্টমস- Customs Act, 1969 (Act No. IV of 1969) এর section 19 এর sub-section (1) এবং মূল্য সংযোজন কর ও সম্পূরক শুল্ক আইন, ২০১২ (২০১২ সনের ৪৭ নং আইন) এর ধারা ১২৬ এর উপ-ধারা (১) এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে সরকার, জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ডের সহিত পরামর্শক্রমে, জনস্বার্থে, নিম্নবর্ণিত শর্তে সিএনজি ফিলিং স্টেশন স্থাপন ও সিএনজি কার্যক্রম পরিচালনার জন্য আমদানিকৃত যন্ত্রপাতি, যন্ত্রাংশ ও পণ্যের (সিএনজি কনভার্শন কিট ও সিএনজি সিলিন্ডারসহ) উপর আরোপণীয় আমদানি শুল্ক, যে পরিমাণে মূল্যভিত্তিক ৩ (তিন) শতাংশের অতিরিক্ত হয় সেই পরিমাণ, এবং সমুদয় মূল্য সংযোজন কর ও সম্পূরক শুল্ক, যদি থাকে, এতদ্বারা অব্যাহতি প্রদান করিল, যথা:—

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of the Act empowers the government to grant exemptions from customs duty in the public interest, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of the Act authorizes the government to grant exemptions from value added tax and supplementary duty.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is the body required to be consulted by the government before issuing notifications for the exemption of duties and taxes.
Imported Machinery and Equipment: Machinery, equipment, and spare parts imported for the setup and operation of CNG filling stations are granted exemptions from customs duty exceeding a specified percentage of the value.
These items, including CNG conversion kits and cylinders, are also granted full exemption from value added tax and supplementary duty.
Customs Duty: An exemption is provided for the portion of customs duty that exceeds a fixed percentage of the value of imported goods for CNG operations.
Value Added Tax: Full exemption from value added tax is granted for goods imported for the establishment and operation of CNG filling stations.
Supplementary Duty: Full exemption from supplementary duty is granted for goods imported for the establishment and operation of CNG filling stations.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: (১) আমদানিকৃত যন্ত্রপাতি ও যন্ত্রাংশ (সিএনজি কনভার্শন কিট ও সিএনজি সিলিন্ডারসহ) সিএনজি ফিলিং স্টেশন স্থাপন ও সিএনজি কার্যক্রম পরিচালনার জন্য ব্যবহৃত হইবে মর্মে জ্বালানি ও খনিজ সম্পদ বিভাগের অন্যূন যুগ্ম-সচিব পদমর্যাদা সম্পন্ন কোন কর্মকর্তা চালান-ওয়ারী পরিশিষ্ট-১ অনুযায়ী একটি প্রত্যয়নপত্র প্রদানসহ উহার একটি অনুলিপি জ্বালানি ও খনিজ সম্পদ বিভাগ কর্তৃক সংশ্লিষ্ট কাস্টম হাউস বা কাস্টমস স্টেশনে প্রেরণ করিবেন;

CNG Conversion Kit: This item is subject to specific certification requirements when imported for the establishment and operation of CNG filling stations.
CNG Cylinder: These components, when imported for CNG filling station operations, require a specific certificate from the Energy and Mineral Resources Division.
Energy and Mineral Resources Division: A designated official from this division, holding at least the rank of Joint Secretary, must issue a certificate for the import of specific CNG-related machinery and parts. This division is also responsible for sending a copy of the certification to the relevant Customs House or Customs Station.
Customs House: Customs authorities at these locations receive official certification from the Energy and Mineral Resources Division to verify the intended use of imported CNG machinery and equipment.
Customs Station: These stations are authorized to receive formal documentation from the Energy and Mineral Resources Division confirming the appropriate use of imported goods for CNG operations.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: (২) এই প্রজ্ঞাপনের আওতায় রেয়াত প্রাপ্ত আমদানিকৃত যন্ত্রপাতি ও যন্ত্রাংশ অন্যবিধ কোন উদ্দেশ্যে ব্যবহৃত হইলে আমদানিকারক কাস্টমস কর্তৃপক্ষের গৃহীত আইনানুগ যে কোন ব্যবস্থা মানিয়া লইতে বাধ্য থাকিবেন মর্মে আমদানিকৃত পণ্য খালাসের সময়, সংশ্লিষ্ট কাস্টমস কমিশনার বরাবরে, পরিশিষ্ট-২ অনুযায়ী একটি অঙ্গীকারনামা দাখিল করিবেন;

Customs Authority: The Customs Authority is empowered to take legal action if imported machinery or parts granted a duty concession are used for any unauthorized purpose.
Importer: An importer must submit an undertaking in a specific format to the relevant Commissioner of Customs at the time of clearing the goods, agreeing to accept legal consequences if the duty-free goods are used for non-permitted purposes.
Commissioner of Customs: The importer is required to submit a formal undertaking to the Commissioner of Customs as a condition for clearing machinery and equipment that has received a tax concession.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: (৩) সিএনজি ফিলিং স্টেশন স্থাপন ও কার্যক্রম পরিচালনার সাথে সরাসরি সম্পৃক্ত নহে এইরূপ তফসিলে বর্ণিত কনজিউম্যাবল পণ্য এই প্রজ্ঞাপন বলে রেয়াত প্রাপ্ত হইবে না।

Consumable Goods: Consumable goods that are not directly related to the establishment and operation of CNG filling stations are excluded from the duty concessions granted under this notification.
CNG Filling Station: The operation and establishment of CNG filling stations serve as the criteria for determining eligibility for duty exemptions under this regulatory order.

Consumable Goods: Consumable goods are defined as imported items described in the schedule that are used for the establishment or operation of CNG filling stations.
These goods are characterized by being entirely or partially exhausted through direct or indirect use, or by losing their capacity for reuse.

Statutory Regulatory Order: This notification specifies the date on which the legal instrument officially enters into force.

CNG Filling Station: This certificate confirms that a designated entity is authorized to establish and operate a CNG filling station.
Equipment and machinery imported for the establishment and operation of a CNG filling station must be utilized exclusively for those purposes in compliance with notification conditions.
Imported Machinery and Equipment: Machinery and equipment imported for the purpose of setting up a CNG filling station must be certified as being directly related to the authorized business activities.
The imported goods must correspond to the descriptions, quantities, and values stated in the provided invoice and shipping documents like the bill of lading, airway bill, or truck receipt.

Customs Act 1969: The Act provides the legal framework under which appropriate customs authorities may take action against entities that violate import declarations or misuse imported goods.
Imported Machinery and Parts: These goods must be imported specifically for the establishment and operation of a filling station. If the machinery is used or installed for any unauthorized purpose or location, the importer is obligated to pay all applicable duties and taxes.

Consumable Goods: This clause provides a comprehensive list of goods classified as consumable items under the specified regulatory conditions. These items, when imported, are subject to the specific restrictions and administrative requirements set for consumable goods.
Steel Sheet: Steel sheets meeting specific American Standard Testing Method specifications and thickness requirements are categorized as consumable goods under this schedule.
Chemicals: All types of chemicals are classified as consumable goods and fall under the scope of this regulatory provision.
Air Conditioner: Air conditioners with a cooling capacity up to a specified threshold are included in the list of consumable goods.
Household and Personal Baggage: General household goods are formally listed as consumable items subject to the provisions of this schedule.
First Schedule: The list of consumable goods includes specific categories of vehicles as defined under the headings of the First Schedule of the Customs Act 1969.
Customs Act 1969: This act serves as the foundational legal reference for defining the classification of goods, specifically regarding the vehicle headings listed in the First Schedule.
